note: How Ultracite came to turn these rules on, from `git log -S` in this repository (exhaustive-deps, useExhaustiveDependencies, useHookAtTopLevel, eslint-plugin-react-hooks, react/exhaustive-deps, react/rules-of-hooks, set-state-in-effect, exhaustive-effect-dependencies, rule-suppression), packages/cli/CHANGELOG.md, and `gh issue view` / `gh search issues` (read-only). One rater. No issue or PR discusses the dependency rule's merits; the recorded reasons are policy (every rule on) and tool upgrades.

events.subject: Specific Ultracite configurations (#319)
events.what: The Biome react preset sets correctness/useExhaustiveDependencies and correctness/useHookAtTopLevel to error (no options).

events.subject: V7 (#466)
events.what: The ESLint react preset turns on every non-deprecated eslint-plugin-react-hooks rule as error (rules/react-hooks.mjs), with an explicit react-hooks/exhaustive-deps override; the Oxlint react preset lists react/exhaustive-deps and react/rules-of-hooks.

events.subject: Drop redundant react-hooks/exhaustive-deps override
events.what: The explicit override goes; the every-rule loop already sets it to error.

events.subject: Extend cross-linter parity to framework presets and add a parity check
events.what: react-hooks/* is normalised to react/* in compare-rule-parity.ts, so the Oxlint and ESLint react presets must agree on these rules.

events.subject: Update the oxlint presets for oxlint 1.79
events.what: Oxlint 1.79 split its nursery react/react-compiler rule into 22 React Compiler rules (exhaustive-effect-dependencies, memo-dependencies, set-state-in-effect, no-deriving-state-in-effects, rule-suppression, refs, purity, …). All 22 were turned on as error, 'matching the ESLint react preset (which already errors on every non-deprecated eslint-plugin-react-hooks rule)'.
